params.caption: 🎮 MindsEye studio Build A Rocket Boy reportedly owes £62M The studio founded by former GTA producer Leslie Benzies is said to owe around £62 million. About £36.5 million of that is owed to NetEase, and more than £1 million to Benzies himself. Litigation is reportedly the main plan for paying it back. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 17:05 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 😬 React if you saw this coming · 💬 Can the studio recover? #MindsEye #BuildARocketBoy #NetEase #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
